items.title: Frontend Development
items.text: Modern, performant frontend architectures using React, Next.js, Angular, and TypeScript with responsive layouts and accessible components.

items.title: AI Assistant Interfaces
items.text: Conversational assistant UIs, clarification questions, agent responses, and follow-up flows using CopilotKit, AG-UI, and Claude Managed Agents.

items.title: Mobile (Flutter)
items.text: Cross-platform mobile apps and chatbot MVPs built with Flutter and Dart, with production releases to the Apple App Store.

items.title: Auth and API Integration
items.text: Secure frontend authentication flows, session handling, and REST API integration consuming services through Node.js gateways.
